name: Kameničná (Czechia)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of green and yellow, with a yellow linden tree with green leaves on a stepped base counterchanged yellow and black bearing a black and yellow linden sprig.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 31 May 2005 (decision No. 55) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
